conventions.pairing: same initial beliefs, graph, wealth quantiles, evidence and contacts; cash hashes equal across influence rules and opponent probabilities at each income setting
conventions.replay: make_sweep_inputs retains original first 500 rounds, then SeedSequence([seed, 1398228293, stream]); config, seed, distribution and opponent_fraction fully determine inputs
conventions.tanh: recipient opening wealth W_i * tanh(payment / W_i - kappa), kappa=opponent_threshold for baseline opponents and zero for allies; W_i=0 gives zero weight; signs recalculated each contact
conventions.self_weight: fixed degree * reference_payment * (1-social_rate)/social_rate in all arms
conventions.income: income_rate * opening wealth; requested payments must be affordable from opening wealth and at most income; skip, do not clip; simultaneous income and transfers
conventions.cash_balance: total wealth divided by initial total and (1+income_rate)^round must equal one; reported maximum relative error; cumulative cash is nominal, unadjusted for income growth
conventions.effective_opponent_flip_fraction: fraction of scheduled baseline-opponent contacts carrying strictly positive influence each round; zero at round zero and at rounds with no such contacts
conventions.fraction_paying: fraction of scheduled contact attempts with strictly positive actual payment; zero at round zero
conventions.uncertainty: sample SD across seeds, not confidence intervals
conventions.belief_mse: mean posterior variance plus mean squared error of posterior means about true_bias
conventions.late_windows: exact per-round means on inclusive [T//2+1,3*T//4] and [3*T//4+1,T]
conventions.limitations: finite grid and support-erasing signed projection; no frozen-agent certificate applies when baseline opponents can become attractive; fixed self-weight makes income-driven wealth growth increase tanh social strength; no equilibrium claim
